title: SE implementation scratchpad - Riverbank Savings
content:
Context:
- Customer: Riverbank Savings (regional bank). POC to replace existing chatbot + secure document retrieval. Sensitive PII; must run in Private (VPC) or Dedicated with KMS integration.
- Primary goal: secure, low-latency Q&A over deposits/loans knowledge base and account help. No write access to accounts from model.
- Timeline: POC demo requested week of 2026-03-10.

High-level plan / requirements:
- Private deployment preferred (customer policy) but for POC Dedicated with VPC peering might be acceptable. Confirm network constraints with infra team.
- KMS for encryption of model keys + audit logs retention 1y (they asked for 12 months).
- Model: start with smaller curated open model (e.g., llama-3-8b-like quantized) for cost and latency. Provide fallback to 13B variant only if accuracy drop observed.
- Embeddings: use vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate customer already uses?). Ask CS: do they have a preferred vector DB? If not, recommend managed vector store in customer VPC or Dedicated instance of Redwood Optimize caching for retrieval.

Config notes (initial POC profile):
- Deployment: Dedicated pool (2x A10G-equivalent or 1x A100-80GB burst) — iterate after profiling.
- Quantization: 4-bit (q4) for 8B model; profile outputs for hallucination rate.
- KV cache TTL: 30s per session; prefix caching enabled for common greetings to reduce token usage.
- Batching: batch window 10ms to hit throughput targets at demo loads (estimate 20 rps peak).
- Routing policy: primary = low-latency region (us-east1), fallback = us-central dedicated pool.

Security / compliance checklist (for POC):
- VPC peering setup (network team): need subnet ranges + contact. -> TODO (Marco) due 2026-03-02
- KMS key provisioning + HSM option? -> TODO (Priya) confirm by 2026-03-04
- Audit log shipping to customer SIEM (S3 -> Glue) -> verify retention policy -> TODO (Alex) 2026-03-05
- Data handling: redact SSNs and account numbers at ingestion. Add scrubber in retrieval pipeline (Lambda).

Integration / implementation steps (scratch):
1) Export KB from Riverbank Confluence (cust provided). Clean docs, split into chunks ~500 tokens.
2) Build embeddings pipeline (local dev script): /scripts/rb/embed-and-upload.sh (prototype).
3) Deploy model on Dedicated pool with sample config:
   - Model: rb-llama-like-8b-q4
   - Route: /rb/v1/chat -> model alias: rb-poc-2026-03
   - Rate limits: 10 rps / 60s for demo
4) Implement retrieval plugin: prioritize passages with source metadata + doc id for traceability.
5) Add prompt guardrails: system prompt includes "do not provide account info; escalate to human".

Notes from call 2026-02-19 with Riverbank SE + Security:
- They require explicit proof that models won't leak PII. They asked for red-team example prompts.
- Want latency < 300ms for single-turn responses under demo load.
- Interested in on-prem option long-term (air-gapped).

Open questions / blockers:
- Vector DB: customer will check with vendor team; need answer by 2026-03-02. If they are using in-house DB, confirm network access and credentials.
- Exact SLA expectations for Dedicated POC (uptime vs. latency).
- Legal: need DPA addendum for POC - legal already looped in (Confluence link in linked_artifacts).

Action items (quick todo list):
- [ ] Finalize model variant and quantization settings after a quick perf run (Alex) - target 2026-03-01
- [ ] Confirm VPC peering details with Riverbank network team (Marco) - target 2026-03-02
- [ ] Provision KMS key and confirm HSM requirement (Priya) - target 2026-03-04
- [ ] Prepare demo script + test dataset (sanitized) for 03/10 demo (Alex + Priya) - target 2026-03-07
- [ ] Create rollback/fallback plan if accuracy degrades (document in Confluence) (Marco) - target 2026-03-05

Quick troubleshooting snippets / commands:
- Upload embeddings (local dev): ./scripts/rb/embed-and-upload.sh --source ./kb/cleaned --index-name riverbank-poc
- Start local test server: RB_DEV=1 ./tools/start-dev-server --model rb-llama-like-8b-q4 --port 8080
- Example Redwood API route (dev): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments/rb-poc-2026-03/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"How do I open a savings account?"}'

Brain dump / ideas for follow-ups:
- Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation + verification layer: run answers through a verification classifier to check for PII leakage.
- Could use lightweight hybrid search (FAISS + re-rank) to get better precision on KB.
- Post-demo: propose Dedicated + Optimize bundle for cost savings (show perf vs cost curves).

Notes-to-self / informal:
- Keep onboarding steps minimal for demo; avoid on-prem complexities until later phase.
- When in doubt, prefer customer visibility: show logs, sources, trace IDs in demo.
- Add a slide with "what could go wrong" and clear rollback steps.

References / links:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-RB-ONBOARD
- JIRA: JIRA-RB-1234 (epic)
- GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rb-integration-pr

Last quick status: waiting on network ranges from customer (blocking VPC peering). Prioritize that ask this week.
